overlaps.description: why: I1 defines the canonical publish vs sync command contract on the runtime surfaces that I2 rewires, especially the top-level CLI grammar; impact: implementing I2 before I1 would risk baking transitional materialize semantics into the new CLI and sync runtime; action: lock the command split and edge-case contract in I1 before changing the concrete publish/sync handlers in I2.

why: I1 changes the canonical planning/runtime rule language that I3 then propagates through workflows, help, and regression coverage; impact: rewriting docs and tests before the final contract exists would create drift and likely require rework; action: finish the publish vs sync policy rewrite in I1 before performing the canonical docs/help/test cleanup in I3.
